purpose: Identify duplicate layouts, duplicate route constants, duplicate API clients and weak placeholders

duplicateLayouts.similarityReason: Both compose public header/main/footer behavior, but RootLayout delegates to legacy Layout.
duplicateLayouts.recommendation: Investigate; keep until RootLayout has zero runtime ownership proof.

duplicateLayouts.similarityReason: PublicNavbar and common/Footer are pure re-export adapters over Header and Footer.
duplicateLayouts.recommendation: Keep as compatibility adapters until Stage 1.2 proves and migrates callers.

duplicateLayouts.similarityReason: Normalized source similarity is 0.766; auth checks, grid variables, skip links, topbar/content structure, and shell state are repeated.
duplicateLayouts.recommendation: Consolidate shared primitives later, preserve role wrappers and policy.

duplicateLayouts.similarityReason: Admin repeats grid, auth loading, access redirects, skip link, sidebar widths, topbar/main layout.
duplicateLayouts.recommendation: Investigate a tested shared shell primitive; do not merge role policy.

duplicateLayouts.similarityReason: Provider/client shell similarity is 0.981 and only component/data attribute names differ.
Provider/client drawers have normalized similarity 0.965; admin repeats the lifecycle inline.
duplicateLayouts.recommendation: Extract only after keyboard/browser regression tests.

duplicateLayouts.similarityReason: Normalized source similarity is 0.845 with repeated menu lifecycle and account helpers.
duplicateLayouts.recommendation: Share account/menu primitives later; retain role-specific action slots.

duplicateLayouts.similarityReason: Normalized similarity is 0.778 against provider topbar; menu lifecycle and identity helpers repeat.
duplicateLayouts.recommendation: Investigate shared topbar primitives; separately classify search as placeholder.

duplicateLayouts.similarityReason: All are thin wrappers around the same SidebarCore contract.
duplicateLayouts.recommendation: Keep thin wrappers; consolidate only truly generic footer/brand helpers.

duplicateLayouts.similarityReason: WorkspaceLayout is a re-export, while SaaSLayout supplies PageHeader and content wrapper inside DashboardLayout.
duplicateLayouts.recommendation: Investigate import normalization only; keep semantic distinction from DashboardLayout.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: client/src/constants/routes.js
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Keep compatibility; document canonical names before alias cleanup.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: AppRoutes plus route constants/metadata
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Investigate RootLayout ownership and replace only after route-shell tests.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: PUBLIC_ROUTES in client/src/constants/routes.js
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Migrate later to route constants; do not redesign CTAs in this audit.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: AUTH_ROUTES and PUBLIC_ROUTES
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Map active Auth versus Login/Register pages before consolidating literals.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: PUBLIC_ROUTES and DASHBOARD_ROUTES
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Use constants and access-policy helper during a later tested route cleanup.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: ADMIN_ROUTES
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Keep page unmapped; determine ownership before deletion or reuse.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: ROUTES.DASHBOARD plus getPrimaryDashboardPath for role-aware cases
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Classify each fallback context before replacing with role-aware helper.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: DYNAMIC_ROUTES.PUBLIC_PROFILE and getProfileRoute
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Inventory callers and migrate to one route builder later.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: DYNAMIC_ROUTES.PUBLIC_CHALLENGE
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Add a canonical challenge route builder before migration.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: DYNAMIC_ROUTES.MARKETPLACE_CATEGORY and MARKETPLACE_SERVICE
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Use buildRoute helpers after verifying slug versus serviceId contracts.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: CLIENT_ROUTES.DASHBOARD is current client-shell root; compatibility intent of dashboard aliases is unresolved.
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Decide alias policy in route ADR; do not delete paths without usage/runtime evidence.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: AppRoutes is runtime authority; product ownership is unresolved.
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Map endpoint/page ownership before selecting a canonical route.

duplicateRouteConstants.pathOrConstant: Shared UI paths also used as API-relative paths
duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: Route constants for browser paths; apiEndpoints for HTTP paths
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Preserve separate typed namespaces and remove API literals later.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: No single canonical version-builder exists; apiClient owns base URL only.
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Stage 5 should define version ownership before consolidation.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: navigationActive.js is the universal sidebar helper; public ownership is not unified.
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Compare behavior tests before reusing shared helper in Header.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: No single source fully covers dynamic, metadata-gap, and role fallback cases.
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Stage 4 ADR/tests must establish precedence before consolidation.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: accessPolicy.js contains implementation.
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Keep compatibility until imports are mapped; delete only after proof.

duplicateRouteConstants.pathOrConstant: API endpoint constants versus legacy literals
duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: apiEndpoints.js where a contract exists; backend API inventory for actual mounts
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Create a method-level migration map in Prompt 6; do not bulk-replace.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: AppRoutes is runtime authority; routeMetadata is incomplete supporting registry.
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Complete metadata only after route alias policy is decided.

duplicateRouteConstants.sourceOfTruth: AppRoutes is runtime authority; public navigation marks future availability.
duplicateRouteConstants.recommendation: Keep future navigation disabled; decide route ownership before enabling.

duplicateApiClients.authHandling: apiClient injects useAuthStore token, credentials, and refresh; api.js also delegates auth calls to authService.
duplicateApiClients.baseUrlHandling: apiClient resolves clientEnv VITE_API_BASE_URL aliases and local/prod fallback; api.js delegates to apiClient.
duplicateApiClients.recommendation: Retain apiClient; create method-level facade migration evidence before changing api.js.

duplicateApiClients.authHandling: authService owns login/register/refresh/logout; api.js re-exports similarly named wrapper functions.
duplicateApiClients.recommendation: Map method callers and preserve compatibility until all auth flows are tested.
Build caller-by-method map before deprecating facade exports.
Keep both until importer migration and dashboard response tests exist.

duplicateApiClients.authHandling: Per-call skipUserAuth flags and canonical interceptor.
duplicateApiClients.baseUrlHandling: Both ultimately use apiClient base URL.
duplicateApiClients.recommendation: Prompt 6 should compare every facade method with endpoint constants/backend mounts.

duplicateApiClients.baseUrlHandling: Each reads API_BASE_URL and conditionally prepends /v1.
duplicateApiClients.recommendation: Define version ownership in API ADR before extracting a shared helper.
Verify shape differences before sharing a helper.
Prompt 6 should determine whether upload/header calls belong in profileService; do not move without tests.

duplicateApiClients.authHandling: Socket connection receives current auth/session behavior separately from HTTP interceptors.
duplicateApiClients.baseUrlHandling: messagingSocket derives realtime base URL from apiClient/client env.
duplicateApiClients.recommendation: Keep separate; document shared environment/auth contract.

duplicateApiClients.authHandling: External fetch options differ; no frontend session interceptor.
duplicateApiClients.baseUrlHandling: leadScraper fetches caller-provided/external URLs; frontend apiClient targets ScaleOps API.
duplicateApiClients.recommendation: Keep distinct; security-review outbound URL validation separately.

topRisks: LAY-001: active PublicLayout coexists with RootLayout/Layout compatibility shell policy.
LAY-003: provider and client protected shells repeat auth/grid/state behavior and can drift.
LAY-004: admin shell forks mobile/state/content behavior from provider/client shells.
RTE-011: /client, /dashboard/client, and /dashboard/workspace have unresolved alias ownership.
RTE-012: three admin proof route concepts can point users to different placeholder/operational surfaces.
RTE-016: route classification and fallback policy spans constants, metadata, validation, and access policy.
RTE-018: legacy API facade embeds endpoint strings beside the endpoint constant registry.
API-001: 29-importer legacy facade overlaps the canonical 27-importer Axios client and feature services.
WPH-028/WPH-029/WPH-030: business-looking service, portfolio, and testimonial fallback records can mask empty/error states.
WPH-036/WPH-037: auth throttling and production email-provider TODOs remain operational security gaps.
unknowns: Runtime ownership of six unmapped/indirect page files is not proven.
Canonical client dashboard entry among /client, /dashboard/client, and /dashboard/workspace is undecided.
Canonical admin proof route among /admin/proofs, /admin/proof-assets, and /admin/proof-review is undecided.
Canonical long-term API version between /api and /api/v1 is undecided.
Method-level runtime usage of every export in the 29-importer legacy API facade requires Prompt 6 verification.
RootLayout may be compatibility-only by static imports, but runtime/dynamic use must be proven before removal.
